source_capture_policy.admission_rule: Do not admit ETF flow features until each issuer's original daily file, shares outstanding, XRP-per-share factor, NAV/net assets, publication time and cash creation/redemption record are captured and independently reconciled.

limitations: The aggregate includes six spot ETF products plus the BITW multi-asset index sleeve.
The two-day -194,875 XRP figure is derived from holdings changes, not directly verified AP cash creations/redemptions.
GXRP daily flow was withheld because of an issuer-page capture gap; XRPR and BITW have different product structures and should not be treated as identical spot ETF exposures.
Daily flow universe contains four issuer files: XRP/Bitwise, XRPZ/Franklin Templeton, XRPC/Canary Capital and TOXR/21Shares.
GXRP is not collected daily because of an automated bot challenge; its displayed holdings are a stale quarter-end SEC figure and are excluded from daily flow totals.
XRPR is not counted because it is a 1940 Act fund with indirect holdings through other ETPs; its direct coin file is not a complete holdings/flow measure.
The page explicitly defines flow as the change in XRP held: creations minus redemptions, plus staking rewards where applicable, less coins sold for fees or cash payouts.
The November 4 row is partial at 3 of 4 funds; Franklin Templeton XRPZ had not yet published.
The page says zero means the funds that reported showed no money moving in or out; a dash means not all funds have reported.
The page is T+1 and partial, so the zero is not a completed all-funds daily total.
The page's live summary can change as issuers publish; no original issuer files or AP cash records were preserved in this capture.

cryptokeyhole.method: holdings change, including creations/redemptions, staking rewards, fee sales and cash payouts

cryptoetf_today.definition: 0 means the funds that have reported show no money moved in or out; missing funds are not treated as zero.

cross_provider_reconciliation.explanation: The holdings totals are not the same universe: XRP Insights includes six spot products plus BITW and different quarterly/indirect exposures; CryptoKeyhole's daily total contains four issuer files and excludes GXRP and XRPR from daily totals.
cross_provider_reconciliation.comparison_rule: Do not average -194,875 XRP, -3,339 XRP and 0 XRP. They refer to different dates, universes, source vintages and flow definitions.
cross_provider_reconciliation.source_independence: All three aggregators use issuer-published files or derived issuer data. Their capture and calculation methods differ, but they are not three independent measurements of cash creation/redemption.
interpretation: XRP Insights' two-day negative holdings delta is not proof of dollar or XRP cash redemptions.

CryptoKeyhole's repeated -3,339 XRP daily XRPC change may reflect fees or other holdings adjustments; its own method explicitly includes fee sales and cash payouts, so it cannot be called investor redemptions without issuer/AP confirmation.
Crypto ETF Today's zero is partial and only describes funds that had reported at its publication cutoff.
The three observations are not contradictory once dates, fund universes and methods are kept separate.

counter_hypotheses.hypothesis: Negative holdings deltas may reflect fees, cash payouts, staking rewards, index rebalancing or indirect fund structure rather than net investor redemptions.
